rule: The MIXAT screening split is the first 50 clips of the seeded Part 2 draw recorded in the source manifest; the held-out split is every other selected MIXAT clip (200) plus the 200 selected FLEURS test clips (ar_eg 100, en_us 100) as a regression guard; the held-out split excludes every screening clip and is frozen before any scored held-out run.
